acceptance: Two consecutive builds from one bundle produce an identical results.duckdb, or the deploy digests deliberately exclude it with the reason recorded. Evidence: both builds listed.
description: Two builds of the site from the same certified inputs differ only in results/data/results.duckdb. Found while comparing genuine schema-4 and schema-5 builds during the docs cutover; the difference is schema-independent, so it is a producer defect, not a migration effect. It weakens any digest or byte comparison that covers the Explorer artifact.
